assay: bulk RNA-seq of magnetically isolated circulating NK cells (Illumina HiSeq 2500, PE100), HTSeq raw counts + Cufflinks FPKM (S2.5.p2)
samples: 9 B-cell ALL children in remission + 9 age/sex-matched healthy controls, each sampled before (baseline) and immediately after (peak) one acute cycling session = 36 libraries (ABS.p2, S2.5)
primary_estimand: Difference between ALL-in-remission and control children in the within-subject NK-cell transcriptome response to an acute exercise bout (group x time interaction, paired by child) (S2.6.p2, S3.p3)
planned_contrasts: group x time interaction: (ALL post-pre) - (CON post-pre), paired (S3.p3; paper: 179 genes, 163 negative / 16 positive, p<0.01, Suppl. Table S3)
baseline ALL vs CON (S3.p2; paper: 284 genes, 124 up / 160 down, p<0.01, Suppl. Table S1) - disease contrast, not an exercise effect
within-group post vs pre in ALL (Suppl. Table S6) and in CON (Suppl. Table S7) (S3.p3; counts not stated in the text)
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.38.3 on raw counts, paired design (subject), multifactor design with interaction terms (S2.6.p2)

paper_results.named_genes: IL1B down in ALL post vs pre (log2FC -1.68, p<0.001) but not in CON (-0.18, p=0.59) (S4.p6); TREM1, S100A8/A9/A12 down in ALL only (S4.p4-p5)

pathway_method: QIAGEN IPA canonical pathways, FDR<0.05 (S2.6.p2) - proprietary, not reproducible here
